heads.en: Wong In-hoon's resignation is 11 days away! To break off the GTA 6 Executive Director, Nvidia Inhoon resigned for less than two weeks for the extramarital scandal, and on Monday (23rd) shocked the announcement of a new executive, not only to revive the global AI supply chain and stock market, but also to set off a "miscreal wave" in social media! A number of netizens and game fans have opened up their creative brainholes, creating a six-gauge map, and the "Leathing Wave" of Hwang In-hoon is actually just taking 11 days to get rid of the newly listed game "Ganta Six." In-hoon returned home 11 days ago.

heads.t: 川普力保黃仁勳復職遭批 美政壇質疑：為了股市犧牲國安 美國總統川普親自介入，讓陷入風波的輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳重新掌舵，市場也迅速給出正面回應。黃仁勳23日復職後，輝達股價收盤暴漲逾30％，市值單日增加約1兆美元，連帶推升標普500指數大漲4.7％。不過，這場看似振奮市場的回歸，卻在美國政界掀起另一波爭論，外界質疑川普為了維持AI產業與股市榮景，恐怕已將華爾街利益置於國家安全之上。 20 分鐘前｜國際 川普力保黃仁勳復職遭批 美政壇質疑：為了股市犧牲國安 20 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The U.S. political forum questioned the reinstatement of Hwang Jin-hoon in Trumpley: The US President Trump himself stepped in to sacrifice his country for the stock market, let Nvidia’s chief executive Hwang Jin-hoon return to the helm and the market responded positively. When Huang In-hoon was reinstated on 23rd, stock prices rose by over 30%, the market value increased by about $1 trillion a day, and the index of 500 was significantly increased by 4.7%. However, this seemingly virulent return to the market has triggered another controversy in American politics, and it is feared that Trump has put Wall Street’s interests above national security in order to preserve the interests of the AI industry and the stock market. 20 minutes ago, the government of the United States questioned the return of Hong In-hoon to his post at the international level.
